description: Backlog item — one piece of work the platform loop carries from open to shipped: open, then working (on next), in cut (on the day's release branch), validated (on 71/test), shipped (promoted). The chair report reads its state.

state.description: Where the item is in the loop: open → working → in_cut → validated → shipped.

raised_by.description: Who raised it (a person or a session).

commits.description: The commits that carry it, by repository, once it is worked.

release.description: The release that shipped it (YYYYMM.DD.N), once shipped.
